article.linkText: Missouri hosts No. 17 Kentucky in SEC play
article.story: No. 17 Kentucky (7-3) at Missouri (6-4), Nov. 21 at 7:30 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Missouri by 5.5. Against the spread: Missouri 4-6, Kentucky 7-3. How to watch: SEC Network Key stats Missouri Offense Overall: 402.4 yards per game (47th in FBS) Passing: 249.3 yards per game (40th) Rushing: 153.1 yards per game (73rd) Scoring: 29.3 points per game (57th) Missouri Defense Overall: 347.1 yards per game (59th in FBS) Passing: 239.8 yards per game (113th) Rushing: 107.3 yards per game (22nd) Scoring: 22.9 points per game (55th) Kentucky Offense Overall: 369.4 yards per game (76th in FBS) Passing: 216 yards per game (80th) Rushing: 153.4 yards per game (71st) Scoring: 28.3 points per game (64th) Kentucky Defense Overall: 362 yards per game (72nd in FBS) Passing: 226.3 yards per game (93rd) Rushing: 135.7 yards per game (55th) Scoring: 25.3 points per game (73rd) Kentucky is 133rd in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert on 48.3% of third downs. Both teams have a +9 turnover margin to rank 8th in the FBS. Missouri is 85th in the FBS averaging 58.2 penalty yards per game, compared to Kentucky's 15th-ranked 40.8 per-game average. Missouri ranks 123rd in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 75% of trips. Team leaders Missouri Passing: Austin Simmons, 2,379 yards, 21 TDs, 3 INTs, 62.3 completion percentage Rushing: Jamal Roberts, 1,133 yards on 228 carries, 9 TDs Receiving: Cayden Lee, 870 yards on 64 catches, 5 TDs Kentucky Passing: Kenny Minchey, 2,160 yards, 15 TDs, 2 INTs, 68.8 completion percentage Rushing: C.J. Baxter, 562 yards on 107 carries, 8 TDs Receiving: Kenny Darby, 601 yards on 49 catches, 3 TDs Last game Missouri was beaten by Georgia 48-21 on Nov. 14. Simmons passed for 175 yards on 17-of-25 attempts (68.0%) with three touchdowns and one interception. Roberts carried the ball 19 times for 62 yards, adding one reception for one yard. Donovan Olugbode put up 67 yards on four catches with one touchdown. Kentucky fell 21-14 to Florida on Nov. 14. Minchey passed for 181 yards on 15-of-26 attempts (57.7%) with one touchdown and no interceptions. He also carried the ball eight times for 1 yard and one rushing touchdown. Jason Patterson carried the ball five times for 22 yards, adding one reception for nine yards. D.J. Miller put up 80 yards on four catches. Next game Missouri hosts Oklahoma on Nov. 28. Kentucky hosts No. 21 Louisville on Nov. 28.
